notes: Guests are stationary room snapshots. Only entering a non-hall room resolves whether they had relocated, using the elapsed-step probability 1-(1-guest_leave)^elapsed. During stalking, a separate 50% isolation roll on room entry can relocate bystanders out of the culprit room when compatible space exists. Ambush entry/question rolls require the culprit physically present with no other guests; halls remain safe. No visible NPC walking or mid-room relocation/activity changes. Danger remains a separate walking-only clock. The true weapon silently doubles danger-clock increments while held. Physical walking steps and guest snapshot probabilities remain unweighted. Silent authored refusal rate is 10%.
stalking_note: While stalking, the murderer never stays in a hall, relocates with the guest_leave rate times stalking_leave_multiplier, and moves into the room the player enters with stalking_follow_chance (2026-11-17, after playtests where the killer sat in the hall). Isolation of bystanders raised to 75%.
